**Owner-rule breach (owl:imports).** TP-R105, R105.1, R105.2 require recording `owl:imports` of the parent catalog and say a pack "may also owl:imports the parent catalog". 40 of 42 shipped `crates/medulla-core/ontology/*.ttl` files carry `owl:imports <http://knuckles.team/kg/core>` (e.g. a2a-v1.ttl:52). Recommended: replace these rows with "a pack class must reach a core class by `rdfs:subClassOf`; `owl:imports` of core is refused/stripped; orphan default `refuse`" and codemod the 40 modules. TP-R102.3 (`ONTOLOGY_CORE_CONFLICT`) is the right base.

## 4. Hot paths
Served: `ConnectorPack.Import` (`connector_pack.rs:142 serve_import` -> `import.rs:45 validate_and_commit` -> `:63 run_import` -> `reproject.rs:72 project_head`), `GraphSchema` ImportOntology/WithdrawOntology (`graph_schema.rs`), `OntologyInspect`, `GraphSchemaClasses`, `AgentComponent.Content` (`component_content.rs`), Decide `tool_subset`.
Never reach one: R650-R652, R800, R801-R805 (types only; no registered method), R079-R080, R100.x skill render (`render_skill_package` absent), R001.6-.9 (prompt render), R094.2-.5. `DataProduct`, `SensitiveDetector`, `PackContractVersion`, `StandaloneGrant` have no use outside `medulla-types`.

## 5. VERIFIED isolation spot check (3 sampled; VERIFIED rows are few here)
- R105.3: proof `crates/medulla-rdf/tests/connector_parent_classes.rs` parses shipped ttl through `medulla_rdf::owl::Reasoner`; no `src/` call. Crate-only.
- R090: proof `crates/medulla-core/src/ontology_codegen.rs:119,133`; `git grep 'ontology_codegen::' src` is empty. Crate-only (build-time use not shown).
- R042 uses `import/capability_t*` under `src/`, so it runs in the served path.

## 6. Five most common gaps
1. Bench-only hot-path rows (R650.6, R651.6, R801.6-R805.6).
2. Generic template rows with no values or test file (R651.2-.5, R800.x).
3. Wiring to unregistered methods (`OntologyDiff`, `GlossaryTermPut`, `ObjectSetQuery`).
4. Wrong owner (R085, R079, R091, R069, R751).
5. Dead path citations (`gen_contract.rs`, `prompt.rs`, line anchors).

## 7. Decisions needed
1. owl:imports: refuse and require `rdfs:subClassOf` (recommended).
2. Catalog projection: arbora batch only (recommended); drop R108.3's `project()` attach.
3. Prompt rendering (R001.8): engine renders and signs the receipt; Meristem guards dispatch (split R002.10).
4. Move R085, R079, R091, R069, R075/76, R751 to their owning specs.
5. Contract generator: restore `gen_contract` or repoint C-R001/R067/R070 to the real tool; LANDED rows need bound tests.
